heading: A Journey Guided by Knowledge and Faith.
lede: These milestones are editable sample entries. Replace each period and description with his actual story. No date or accomplishment below is a claimed fact.

milestones.title: An early interest in astrology
milestones.description: Describe how the interest began: a family practice, a teacher, an almanac, or a question that would not go away. Keep the details that are true to his life.

milestones.title: Learning traditional astrology
milestones.description: Note the lineage, language, and texts he actually studied. Name a teacher only with permission, and only if that person was truly his teacher.

milestones.title: Years of study and practice
milestones.description: This is the long middle: charts read slowly, mistakes corrected, and the habit of explaining a placement in plain words. Replace this with what those years were like for him.

milestones.title: Beginning consultations
milestones.description: Record when he began sitting with people beyond study, and what kind of questions those first consultations held. Do not invent a count of clients.

milestones.title: Professional milestones
milestones.description: Add only milestones you can point to: a talk given, a class taught, a publication, a community that knows his work. Leave this entry until you have one.

milestones.title: Current work and vision
milestones.description: Describe the practice as it is now, and the standard he wants the next years of consultations to keep: clarity, privacy, and fidelity to the tradition he follows.
